title: Trump Sent CIA Chief To Moscow Secretly. Even Top US Officials Had No Idea
summary_full: The unusual mission comes as Trump searches for a new diplomatic route to end Russia's war in Ukraine, while Moscow continues to escalate attacks and resist Washington's efforts to reset relations.
